_description: 2 Rooms x 3 AGs x 21 BMs (R1: AG1=7 + AG2=3; R2: AG2=4 + AG3=7). 4 Clusters x 19 VMs (5 master, 5 learner, 3 l4lb-storage, 5 infra, 1 bastion), all non-routable. Rules: per-cluster master max_per_bm=1, per-cluster non-routable learner max_per_bm=1, master/learner N-1 failover by room. AG spreading via auto_generate_anti_affinity + target_spread={ag:3}.
